svg.title: Single-pass grounding with confidence
svg.desc: Five-panel method figure. Video and query enter one vision-language decoder. Three generated intervals supply detached pooled states to a confidence head. Generation-order NMS and confidence thresholding select the output. Fixed replay, online IoU labels, and set-level GRPO provide separate decoder and head updates, shown with local named targets. The same NMS pool supports multiple inference thresholds. Numerical examples are illustrative.
svg.text: Span pooling (average over interval token states)
